title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Linux Developer Workflows: OpenAI released preview versions of the ChatGPT desktop application and Codex integration natively for Linux environments.
Enterprise AI Protocol Expansion: Box launched an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, enabling secure AI agent access to governed enterprise files.
Capital Markets & Secondary Sales: Reports indicate Anthropic is designing an innovative employee stock sale framework following its upcoming public debut.
Autonomous Inference & Agent Harnesses: Hardware and platform providers, including DigitalOcean and NVIDIA, unveiled specialized execution platforms tailored for long-horizon AI agent workloads.
Entertainment & Culture Highlights: Previews for major 2026 feature films including 'Verity' and 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' generated widespread audience engagement.

items.title: @thsottiaux: ChatGPT & Codex Desktop Apps Arrive on Linux
items.body: OpenAI previewed official ChatGPT desktop application binaries for Linux environments, bringing global shortcuts, native file integration, and local Codex developer workflows.

items.title: @Box: Box Launches Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server
items.body: Box released its enterprise Model Context Protocol server, allowing any AI assistant to securely query corporate documents while strictly enforcing existing organization permissions.

items.title: @digitalocean: Serverless Qwen 3.8 2.4T on NVIDIA B300 GPUs
items.body: DigitalOcean launched serverless inference for Alibaba Cloud's Qwen 3.8 model (2.4T parameter variant) with a 1M token context window powered by NVIDIA HGX B300 hardware.

items.title: @NVIDIAEU: Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for Long-Running AI Agents
items.body: NVIDIA detailed Nemotron 3.5 Lightning, a model optimized specifically for multi-step agent execution, tool verification, and autonomous task delegation.

items.title: @coderabbitai: Granular Review Profiles for Automated Code Review
items.body: CodeRabbit introduced customizable review profiles (Quiet, Chill, and Assertive) to give developer teams control over automated pull request feedback density.

items.title: @TonyZ278264: Recreating Gemini Luminous UI in SwiftUI via Grok 4.5
items.body: Developer Tony Z demonstrated a complete native SwiftUI recreation of Google's Gemini Luminous UI, built in 3 days using Grok 4.5 without prior iOS development experience.

items.title: @theinformation: Anthropic Explores Employee Secondary Sales Structure
items.body: Reports indicate Anthropic is structuring a novel secondary equity program for early employees following its public offering to balance talent retention with liquidity.

items.title: @AlphaSenseInc: SuperAnalyst Multi-Step Research Agent Debut
items.body: AlphaSense introduced SuperAnalyst, an autonomous AI research agent designed to perform multi-step market intelligence, company analysis, and automated monitoring.

items.title: @APompliano: Macro Indicators Support Sustained Bull Market
items.body: Investor Anthony Pompliano highlighted market indicators suggesting sustained upside momentum across broader equity and digital asset markets.

items.title: @castle_tech_: Modeling Corporate Exposure to Macro Events
items.body: Castle Technologies published a macro framework detailing how modern enterprises operate as implicit financial wrappers around underlying energy commodities and tax credits.

items.title: @Codie_Sanchez: Building Autonomous Middle-Market Businesses
items.body: Entrepreneur Codie Sanchez shared key operational frameworks used to scale cash-flowing enterprises that run independently of day-to-day founder management.

items.title: @TheCinesthetic: First Look at Hathaway & Johnson in 'Verity' (2026)
items.body: Initial production stills were released for the upcoming feature film adaptation of Colleen Hoover's psychological thriller 'Verity', starring Anne Hathaway and Dakota Johnson.

items.title: @Variety: Sadie Sink Joins 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' Cast
items.body: Actress Sadie Sink discussed joining Marvel Studios' upcoming 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day', sharing insights into production and working on set.

items.title: @Vfynn_: Zlatan Ibrahimovic Comments on Transfer Market Valuations

items.body: Starlink highlighted ongoing orbital constellation deployments, achieving lower latency for global streaming, remote enterprise operations, and video communications.
